desc: Domain randomisation over severity on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B9's
'must, zero cost' arm: 'resample sigma in [0, 3] per episode, train the
stock learner, evaluate at the committed sigma'.
Host block == ippo/config1.json. The learner is URB's IPPO and is never
told sigma; only the environment changes.
sigma_floor = 1e-9  a draw of exactly 0 would fall off the severity
wrapper's bookkeeping path for one day; the floor keeps it on that
path while being 1.0 to fifteen significant figures. The TEST phase
does not use the floor -- the randomiser is detached entirely, so
evaluating at sigma = 0 is byte-identical to a stock run.
